evals.prompt: Design a database for an e-commerce store using Prisma. I need users, products (with categories), orders, and order items. Users can have multiple addresses. Products have variants (size, color) with separate stock tracking.
evals.expected_output: Prisma schema with User, Product, Category, ProductVariant, Order, OrderItem, Address models with proper relationships, indexes, and migration

evals.prompt: I need a SQLAlchemy schema for a social media app. Users can create posts, follow other users, like posts, and comment on posts. Posts can have multiple images/media attachments.
evals.expected_output: SQLAlchemy models with User, Post, Comment, Like, Follow, Media models, proper relationships, junction tables, and migration
